items.title: Flat pullback is compatible with composition of flat morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for two flat morphisms the flat pullback of the composite is the composite of the flat pullbacks, with the expected relative dimension (statement lines 2286-2297, tag 02RD). Flatness and the relative dimension are immediate from the composition statement, but the equality of the operations requires a real coefficient computation: one reduces to a chain of integral closed subschemes related by the two pullbacks, passes to the local rings at the three generic points, and identifies the two coefficients as lengths which are equal by transitivity of the flat length formula. That length comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
